description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Schedule of the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1469/38 of 03.11.2006 which specifies the Faculties & the Departments of the University of Moratuwa
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically, an amendment to the Schedule of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an official order issued under statutory authority (Section 27(1) of the Act) to modify the organizational structure of the University of Moratuwa by adding a new Faculty of Business with three departments. While a minister's name appears, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function of amending existing legislation and university regulations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
